# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Enrollment Hardening

Requires a network connection during initial setup, so that a device cannot get past enrolment without management.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| checkId | `INTUNE-BASE-141-DEnrollmentHardening` |
| Source | IntuneAdmin/IntuneBaselines — Modern Workplace Expert, Baseline - Require Network In OOBE (TenantLockdown CSP) |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Enrollment_Hardening.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Enrollment_Hardening.json) |

> Works via the TenantLockdown CSP and applies from the next clean installation. Make sure wired or Wi-Fi is available during OOBE — with a fleet without Ethernet and without a pre-configured Wi-Fi profile, the user gets stuck.
